messages:
sarah: quick postmortem follow-up 1: night paging still dominated by proxy-conns and scheduler-backlog. need owners + small fixes. can we avoid paging for obvious maintenance bursts? @oncall-bot drop last-48h counts pls

oncall-bot: 48h counts: proxy-conns=34, scheduler-backlog=27. top services: inference-proxy, batch-scheduler. snapshot: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1743210000

tom: i'll own proxy-conns. plan: increase upstream pool, add connect jitter, and change alert to page only if avg_lat>250ms. infra PR by EOD Tue. will add owner tag tom.

uma: i'll take scheduler-backlog. short term: cap prefetch, switch alert to p95(backlog,5m), add dedupe window 15m. PR by Wed.
sarah: agree 72h monitoring post-rollout. please add a tiny CI smoke to validate dedupe: fire same-key x3 -> expect 1 pager within 15m.

tom: setting canary 5% traffic and dashboard tiles. will add daily one-line status messages here.

uma: will update runbook with queries + rollback steps. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/night-churn (drop PR link when ready).
sarah: I'll open tracking ticket RI-9999 and set daily reminders. format for updates: "tom: proxy canary OK | uma: scheduler PR open"

oncall-bot: reminder set: daily 09:00 UTC until 1743286400 (72h window end).

sarah: thanks all, closing owners: tom(proxy), uma(scheduler). reconvene if noise doesn't drop after 72h.
